text: Before Sep 2026 the plugin wrote events as floating times or with a nonstandard TZID="UTC+03:00" (no VTIMEZONE). Such events still exist on the owner's server, so the read path must keep parsing them. The owner's client is DAVx5 on Android; it rendered the UTC+03:00 style correctly but other clients may not. The owner travels (e.g. London, Milan) while events are often meant in Europe/Athens, so fixed offsets are wrong across DST; always write IANA TZIDs.
author: Stavros Korokithakis <hi@stavros.io>

text: complete_todo does not use caldav's recurring-todo handling (Todo.complete(handle_rrule=True)). Rejected Sep 2026 because caldav computes the next occurrence in UTC, so local times drift by an hour across DST. Completing a recurring todo therefore marks the whole series done; this is documented in the manifest. Revisit only with a DST-correct next-occurrence calculation.
author: Stavros Korokithakis <hi@stavros.io>
